implemented: route allowlist and repository override rejection
minimum-permission positive and negative token probes

p0_required.name: failed-task-resubmission
p0_required.requirement: A prior failed/not_planned task must not permanently block an identical new task as duplicate.

p0_required.name: comment-pagination
p0_required.requirement: All trusted comment scans must paginate and locate terminal states beyond the first 100 comments.

p0_required.name: task-id-binding
p0_required.requirement: A child terminal comment must contain the exact expected governance-generated task_id.

p0_required.name: artifact-contract
p0_required.requirement: Success must include the route-specific Artifact ID, digest, URL and expert final attestation where applicable.

p0_required.name: late-terminal-reconciliation
p0_required.requirement: CONTROL_TIMEOUT and CONTROL_MONITOR_ERROR must be reconciled when a trusted child terminal arrives later.

p0_required.name: lost-trigger-recovery
p0_required.requirement: If a child Issue has no trusted bot activity, perform at most one audited re-trigger and never loop indefinitely.

p0_required.name: gpts-trusted-comment-read
p0_required.requirement: GPT Action must expose read-only Issue comments so GPT can verify github-actions[bot] rather than trust editable Issue body.

p0_required.name: json-complexity-and-secret-variants
p0_required.requirement: Bound JSON depth/node count/string size and reject camelCase or authorization-style secret field variants.

p1_required: daily token and repository identity health check
long-term Issue and Artifact archive policy
